item.title: Getting a Gemini API key is an exercise in frustration
item.description:
📝 I already had Gemini CLI installed, but that only gave me access to Gemini 2. Based on the context, Gemini could refer to: The chatbot available at gemini. I then verified that my key was working with Gemini CLI.

item.title: When would you ever want bubblesort? (2023)
item.description:
📝 On some very particular hardwares bubblesort stills ends up better, like in this NVIDIA study, but you probably don't have that hardware. Bubble sort works pretty well here. Gosh this is so exciting.
🔗 Read more: https://buttondown.com/hillelwayne/archive/when-would-you-ever-want-bubblesort/

item.title: Common Lisp, ASDF, and Quicklisp: packaging explained

item.title: The future of Terraform CDK
item.description:
📝 After running the command, you can use standard Terraform CLI commands (terraform init, terraform plan, terraform apply) to continue managing your infrastructure. Q: Will CDKTF be removed from GitHub. Q: Will CDKTF continue to support new versions of Terraform or providers.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-cdk
